notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.13
notes.notes:
We've recently noticed some problems with playing offline and having spent some time figuring out the problem last week, we're now releasing this hotfix to solve the issue.

Just a reminder for those who participated in the Public Beta and have been subscribed to its branch, to not forget to opt-out of the Beta branch. We've been keeping the Beta branch up-to-date with the latest patches, but we'll no longer be maintaining it and will eventually deactivate it. So please make sure that you're opted out to prevent any possibly complications.

PS: We've also changed some settings in the back-end which will hopefully reduce some problems a part of the players have had with the updates.

notes.title: Update 1.2.12
notes.notes:
Today marks the update of the game with the 1.2.12 update/hotfix that will solve the reported issues with the Librarian and Escape Artist achievements, plus a minor save system improvement.

If you meet the two achievements' criteria, they will be unlocked as soon as you load your saved game in the final map.

We've also taken the opportunity to give our website a facelift and updated our blog accordingly:

 Main website
 Game page
 Blog

PS: We're still working on the Press page, so expect it to be up again soon.

If you face any issues please refer to this guide, if your problem persists please let us know in the support forums or contact us directly at support@koukoustudios.com.

notes.title: Incoming Update 1.2.10
notes.notes:
With this update we’re migrating all Beta patches to the default branch, bringing the the game up to version 1.2.10 and marking the end of the Beta branch. Thanks to those few who helped us out!

Steam Achievements will be available to everyone!

Important Note:
Because the upgrade to the latest version of the UDK modifies a lot of files, the configuration files will be recreated and your in-game settings will most likely be reset.
[olist]
If you want to keep your settings, there’s a number of things you can do:
Take note of your settings and re-apply them;
Make a backup of the following config files and move them back after the update has completed and the game has been started at least once:

UDKSystemSettings.ini
UDKInput.ini

Mark the above configuration files as read-only before the update and remove the mark after having started the game at least once.
[/olist]
We will be rolling out the update this Friday 24th to give you some time to prepare.

Now, onto the changelogs:

1.2.10 Changelog
Enabled Achievements for the default branch;
Minor tweaks.


1.2.9 Changelog
Resolved some reported and unreported issues with the Achievements;
Small improvements to the frame-rate at the start of some levels;
Added anti-Nausea mode in the config. Check out the details here.
Minor improvements to stability.


1.2.7 Changelog
Added support for 19 Steam Achievements;
Upgraded to the latest version of the Unreal Development Kit;
Smoother character animation blending;
Minor AI improvements;
Fixed sound issues.

Update 1.0.11
notes.notes:
The first major update (1.0.11) for Lethe - Episode One is now live. Based on your feedback we made the following changes:

     A FOV slider is now available through the Display Options menu.
     Further improved AI behavior.
     Fixed an issue that wouldn’t allow the players to skip through the intro text.
     Fixed certain collision issues that would allow the players to break the game.
     Fixed an issue that would switch off the HUD if the players open the pause menu while using a toilet.
     Certain notes have been updated.
     Visual pointers to certain puzzle solutions added.
     Minor general visual, technical and gameplay improvements.
     Certain keyboard and controller buttons are now rebindable again.
 
Further physics improvements will follow soon! Thanks for the feedback everyone! Have fun!

Note: User settings have been reset in some cases, due to additions and changes.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.10b
notes.notes:
With this quick hotfix we are addressing some minor issues:

 
    Improved AI behavior in certain areas.
    We tweaked a certain jumping puzzle to be less frustrating.
    Fixed an issue where the player would sink too fast while swimming.
    Tweaked a door in the Laboratory basement that wouldn't allow the proper use of Telekinesis.


We are also working on the first major update that will be introducing general improvements to the game.

notes.title: Lethe gets a Release Date!
notes.notes:
http://www.koukoustudios.com/gfx/LetheTitleLogo.png
Quite some time has passed since being Greenlit, so we thought it was about time to make our Store Page public with all the new media we have been collecting. And in case you might have missed it, we released our new trailer last week. So check it out here or in the video section if you haven't already!

Some of you might have noticed we have updated the descriptions on our pages, because some aspects were too vague and could easily lead to misunderstandings about the nature of the game.

We're currently focusing on a PC-only launch, while aiming for an OS X release some time later this year. Currently we split our time between the Closed Beta, the patching of bugs, finalizing content, doing promotion and whatever else shows up along the way. Thus we might not reply to your messages right away.

Now that all of the previous is out of the way, we are happy to announce that Lethe - Episode One will be released on Steam for PC on August 1st 2016!

For all matters regarding Press and Reviews, we'd kindly request that you contact us at contact@koukoustudios.com.
